# ALCOA+ — data-integrity attributes: clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: the regulated organization and its inspectors decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).

Source: ALCOA+ as used in PIC/S PI 041 and MHRA GXP data-integrity guidance — not fetched (blocked); requirement text is our paraphrase and every clause marked † is unverified: picscheme.org and gov.uk were unreachable when this map was written; the attribute list follows common usage and is unverified; definitions are our paraphrase
